title: mailframe
summary: The encoded lifecycle/inbox contracts and strong draw records now pass bounded deterministic checks. The packet stays implemented/unverified because no refreshed connected-client pixel, input, protocol, dynamic-state or audio capture exists.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI now matches the mailbox lifecycle: local immediate open, one throttled list request, backpack ownership, exact sound transitions, range/close behavior, send-result reset, purse updates, and world-entry pending-mail query.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI now decodes every sender branch correctly, filters expired mail, pages exactly seven rows, resolves sender/item data, distinguishes read state, and exposes COD, expiry and tooltips before opening the selected row.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI now implements mark-read, ask-once item-text body retrieval, reply eligibility, return versus delete, item/money take, COD confirmation, and permanent-letter creation with the exact build-5875 packet shapes.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI now enforces recipient/subject/body, 30-copper postage, purse, 10000-gold COD, attachment and mutually exclusive money/COD gates; it confirms enclosed money, blocks duplicate sends, and resets only on success.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI renders the complete 384x512 inbox shell and seven-row template using the reference art, anchors, read/COD/count/expiry treatments and page controls.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI renders the reference compose stationery, recipient/subject/body inputs, divider and exact UV-cropped inert scrollbar pieces without claiming source-omitted live scrolling or autocomplete.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI renders and wires the cropped attachment slot, money inputs/icons, money/COD radio pair, purse, postage, send/cancel/close controls and tab lifecycle.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI renders the second 384x512 reader adjacent to the inbox with stationery, body, sender, subject, divider, exact cropped scrollbar, attachment slots and state-correct bottom actions.
